name: corporate_sdk
_comment_routes: Pre-fork paas_customer served TermPage/PolicyPage at /term and /policy (customer route map rows 41-42); the path strings are kept so deep links and push payloads keep working. TermPage/PolicyPage are @RoutePage() inside this SDK, but a composed app's auto_route codegen only generates route classes for @RoutePage widgets in the HOST's own lib/, so these entries import the installed templates/routes/corporate_route_pages.dart shell (TermRouteView -> TermRoute, PolicyRouteView -> PolicyRoute), the same ADR-005 shape as auth_sdk's auth_route_pages.dart. Declared at top level: this manifest has no flavour blocks, and the legal pages are correct in every persona. No AppRoutes seam method exists for either page (auth's footer uses embedded_widgets below), so no app_routes entry is declared; add one only when a caller pushes by seam. test/manifest_wiring_test.dart pins the routes <-> shell <-> installs triangle.
_comment_embedded_widgets: corporate_sdk owns policy/terms, so any composition with auth_sdk includes it: auth's login footer links call EmbeddedWidgets.I.policyPage()/termPage() (ADR-005 indirection — auth never imports corporate_sdk directly). PolicyPage/TermPage are this SDK's own pages, exported from the corporate_sdk barrel. No 'imports' are declared here: every installed SDK's barrel is already auto-imported into the @generated-sdk-imports block, so repeating it in the wiring block produced a duplicate_import lint.
